title: Needle-in-RAG: Prompt-Conditioned Character-Level Traceback of Poisoned Spans in Retrieved Evidence
why_relevant: Proposes a forensic traceback framework for character-level localization of poisoned spans in RAG retrieved evidence, with an evaluation protocol across five poisoning attack families and six LLMs.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on post-hoc forensic attribution rather than prevention; suspicious arXiv ID (2605) suggests possibly unverified preprint.
